```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 08_hypothesis_testing_sample_z_score
title: >
  Calculate the z-score for the Sample Mean
questions:
  - id: spider_sample_z
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      A sample of 3 has mean 189. The population mean is 284 and the population
      standard deviation is 50. What is the sample z-score?
    answer: -3.29
    tolerance: 0.01
    explanation: >
      The standard error is 50 / sqrt(3). The z-score is (189 - 284) divided by that
      standard error, about -3.29.
```
